summary.text: Matt Dubnik was first elected in 2016 to the Georgia House of Representatives and represents Gainesville and other portions of Hall County in House District 29.

paragraphs.text: He was born in Gainesville and received a B.S. in management from the Georgia Institute of Technology in 2003.
He previously worked as an information security specialist and as a regional director for Ducks Unlimited, and is chief engagement officer of Forum Communications, a marketing agency.
